strings.name: Paul Tudor Jones
strings.role: Tudor Founder, Co-Chairman and Chief Investment Officer
strings.summary: Paul Tudor Jones founded Tudor in 1980, focusing on discretionary global macro trading. He formerly chaired the New York Cotton Exchange and helped establish the Robin Hood Foundation and JUST Capital. His philanthropy also includes supporting the University of Virginia’s Contemplative Sciences Center with Sonia Jones.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through 17 November 2026. Personal strategies are distinguished from the firm’s multi-manager business, charitable projects from demonstrated effects, and forecasts from events. Only publication details and the description of the 2026 episode were checked.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded Tudor Investment, developed global macro trading and supported anti-poverty philanthropy.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education and academic honors
strings.facts.f1.value: Earned a BA in Economics from the University of Virginia in 1976 and received an honorary doctorate from the University of Glasgow in 2014; these are different types of qualification.
strings.facts.f2.label: Investment responsibilities
strings.facts.f2.value: Tudor Co-Chairman and CIO, focused on discretionary macro trading; the Group also operates other managers’ and quantitative strategies.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Building a global investment business
strings.highlights.h1.text: Founded in 1980, Tudor developed into a multi-asset, multi-manager investment firm; not every strategy is personally his.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Helping build charitable institutions
strings.highlights.h2.text: Co-founded the Robin Hood Foundation addressing poverty in New York and JUST Capital researching corporate behavior, alongside other founders.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Market interview episode published
strings.timeline.t1.text: CNBC’s episode description presents his market outlook; views about 2027 are forecasts, not achieved results.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Receives honorary doctorate
strings.timeline.t2.text: The University of Glasgow recognized his business and philanthropic achievements with an honorary doctorate, not a research doctorate.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Co-founds JUST Capital
strings.timeline.t3.text: Joined people from business, finance and civil society to establish an organization researching corporate behavior.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Supports Contemplative Sciences Center founding
strings.timeline.t4.text: With Sonia Jones, donated $12 million to establish the center at the University of Virginia.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Chairs New York Cotton Exchange
strings.timeline.t5.text: His tenure continued through June 1995; this is a historical exchange role.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Co-founds Robin Hood Foundation
strings.timeline.t6.text: Worked with Peter Borish and Glenn Dubin to establish a charity addressing poverty in New York.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Founds Tudor
strings.timeline.t7.text: Established the firm that later developed into a global multi-manager investment group.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Earns economics degree
strings.timeline.t8.text: Graduated from the University of Virginia with a BA in Economics.
